_note: One entry per benchmark topic. Sources are fetched into bench/.cache/<id>/ by fetch.py and never committed (they are copyrighted). The quiz in quizzes/<id>.json was written from the sources only.

topics.request: explain to me what is Claude Mods from these sources, and give me 3 use cases

topics.notes: The feature is newer than the model's training data: rely only on the sources. Requires Claude Code v2.1.287+; mods are on by default there (the old CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS flag is ignored); individual mods can be disabled via /plugin, broader sets via settings, --safe-mode or org managed settings.

sources.hint: very long design discussion; read the opening post and skim the rest; where it differs from the docs, the docs win
